info.name: Mailchimp Marketing Abuse Connected Sites API

params.name: fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

params.name: offset
params.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this it the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.
